shared_elements: low-relief carving on a rectangular stone surface
justification: Both are low-relief carved panels with figures arranged in horizontal registers, but A shows a dense field of schematic quadrupeds and reptilian creatures in profile with no human presence, while B shows a rayed disc above standing human figures at an offering table over a large block of dense inscribed script. The only correspondence is the generic one of relief figures in rows; the specific motifs (animal swarm vs. radiant disc and adorants above text) share nothing distinctive.
